messages:
Incident Bot: Pager triggered: [SEV3] Synthetic Canary Failure - eu-west (canary-prober)
PagerDuty: <https://pagerduty.example/INC12345|INC12345> triggered by canary-prober in eu-west - multiple consecutive failures
Leo: acked INC12345 :hand: i'm on it
Incident Bot: Leo acknowledged the page (ack by Leo at 2167890130)
Leo: quick check — is this the new canary routing config we rolled an hour ago? @infra-deploy
infra-deploy: yes, rolled routing-table v2 at 2157899000, only to eu-west canaries
Maya: seeing the same in logs — canary-prober returning 504s intermittently, probed host header is wrong sometimes
Sophia: that sounds like the host rewrite rule we added. pushing a revert might stop the failures. want me to revert the rule on the probe fleet? :eyes:
Leo: yes, revert on probe-config first. i'll hold traffic. runbook step 2 -> toggle probe flag
OpsBot: running command: `./proberctl --env eu-west set probe_host_rewrite=false --fleet canary` 
OpsBot: command output: `OK - probe_host_rewrite=false applied to 48 agents`
Leo: monitoring metrics now — probe-error-rate dropping? graphs in #monitoring show spike to 18% at 16:05 UTC
Maya: after the flag toggle errors down to 1.2% in last 30s. looks like revert worked. :tada:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty note: incident status updated to acknowledged -> remediation in progress
Leo: good. holding for 5m to ensure stability, then we'll close the PD alert if green. Sophia can you start a short postmortem doc skeleton? link it in the incident ticket
Sophia: on it — creating doc: `docs/incident/inc-2167890123-canary-routing-failure.md`
Maya: quick customer impact check: real user traffic unaffected; this was synthetic only. but we should confirm no downstream alert noise.
Leo: confirmed — no uptick in frontend 5xxs and no CS tickets. mark customer impact: none (synthetic only)
PagerDuty: Note added to INC12345: "Remediation applied (probe_host_rewrite disabled). Observed error rate decline to baseline. No customer-facing impact detected." 
Leo: handing to next on-call for 15:30 UTC rotation — @Maya you'll take post-incident follow-ups and close PD if stable
Maya: got it. i'll watch for 10m then close PD. adding followup action: rollout validation test for routing-table changes
Incident Bot: Incident INC12345 resolved by Leo at 2167890188 — PagerDuty incident closed
Leo: closing thread — root cause likely faulty host rewrite in routing-table v2 affecting probe header. action items: 1) add canary-only validation before routing-table rollouts, 2) add synthetic smoke after config apply, 3) postmortem by EOD
Sophia: added action items to the doc and assigned owners. cc: @infra-deploy for rollout gating
Maya: closing PD now. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
